title: Idaho IWTU: cumulative treatment advances between two approximate observations
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE reported more than 279,000 gallons treated by January 27, 2026 and nearly 400,000 gallons by June 30, while the state-authorized storage system provided 84 vaults for 1,344 canisters. Denominator: Cumulative IWTU sodium-bearing waste treated since radiological operations began in April 2023, paired with separately authorized interim storage capacity.
